subject: design/doc-link-integrity
statement: The approved design declares its Serves contract as: prd:docgate/FR-21 · prd:docgate/FR-22.
intent: Preserve the approved design-to-requirement coverage contract without assigning targets to unrelated prose decisions.
rationale: The source design's Serves header is the authoritative coverage declaration.
fit_criterion: Every durable, memory-eligible PRD target in the declared header is carried by one serves relation; exact live NG/WR rows remain non-relational context and unresolved targets remain explicit reconciliation findings.
